The purpose of this project is twofold:

1)  to collate all available scRNA-seq and snRNA-seq data that exists for medulloblastoma mediated by the Sonic Hedgehog cell signaling pathway for characterization of cell types and marker gene expression.

2)  to determine how metacell representation of single cell data can be preserved and optimized to categorize cell types.

# Part 1

*Note: It is not necessary to store images until the SHH cells have been filteredm, but I have done so for the processing steps and for the initial UMAP of the full dataset from Riemondy et al 2022 so you can compare to the original publication.*

*Note: Since this dataset contains multiple medulloblastoma cell types, we pre-process the data. Some steps expected in pre-processing after the SHH cells are isolated are not performed.*

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, cache = FALSE}

# Folder to save images in Part 1
img_dir1_Riemondy <- file.path(here(), "Riemondy_analysis", "Riemondy_Images", "Part_1_Images")
  
if (!dir.exists(img_dir1_Riemondy)) dir.create(img_dir1_Riemondy)
```

### Step 1: Import data

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, cache = FALSE}

# Load raw counts matrix
raw_counts <- file.path(here(), 
                        "Riemondy_analysis", 
                        "data", 
                        "GSE155446_human_raw_counts.csv.gz")
counts_Riemondy <- read.csv(raw_counts, row.names = 1)

# Set seed
seed_value_Riemondy <- 20200204

# Convert to matrix format
counts_Riemondy <- as.matrix(counts_Riemondy)
counts_Riemondy <- as(counts_Riemondy, "dgCMatrix")

metafile <- file.path(here(), 
                      "Riemondy_analysis", 
                      "data", 
                      "GSE155446_human_cell_metadata.csv.gz")
metadata_Riemondy <- read.csv(metafile, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}

# Create Seurat object (check cell amount)
Riemondy <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts_Riemondy,
  project = "GSE155446",
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200,
  names.delim = "_",
  names.field = 1
)

rm(counts_Riemondy)

metadata_Riemondy$cell_id <- rownames(metadata_Riemondy)
metadata_Riemondy$cell_id[metadata_Riemondy$cell_id == "934"] <- "943"
metadata_Riemondy$cell_id[metadata_Riemondy$cell_id == "966-2"] <- "966_2"
metadata_Riemondy$recurrence <- ifelse(metadata_Riemondy$cell_id == "966_2",
                                       "Recurrence",
                                       "Non-recurrence")

rownames(metadata_Riemondy) <- metadata_Riemondy$cell_id

Riemondy <- AddMetaData(Riemondy, metadata_Riemondy)
Riemondy[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(Riemondy, pattern = "^MT-")
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache = TRUE}

head(Riemondy@meta.data)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache = TRUE}

cat("Columns in Seurat object:", ncol(Riemondy@meta.data), "\n")
cat("Rows in Seurat object:", nrow(Riemondy@meta.data), "\n")
cat("Number of patients in Seurat object:", length(unique(Riemondy$UPN)), "\n")

```

#### Annotating subtypes

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = FALSE}

Riemondy@meta.data %>% 
  group_by(UPN) %>% 
  summarize(median_percent_mito = median(percent.mt), 
            mean_percent_mito = mean(percent.mt)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(median_percent_mito))

sample_names <- as.character(unique(Riemondy@meta.data$orig.ident))
per_sample <- map(sample_names, ~filter(Riemondy@meta.data, 
                                        orig.ident == .x))

# check Line 232 for relationship between UMI and percent mitochondria

Riemondy <- subset(Riemondy, subset = percent.mt < 30)
Riemondy <- subset(Riemondy, subset = nCount_RNA < 40000)
Riemondy <- subset(Riemondy, subset = nCount_RNA > 500)


annots <- Riemondy@meta.data %>% 
  select(UPN, subgroup) %>% 
  unique() %>%
  arrange(subgroup)

subgroup_order <- c(
  "SHH",
  "GP3",
  "GP3/4",
  "GP4",
  "WNT"
)

```

#### Scree plot (selecting top PCs)

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = FALSE}

annots <- mutate(annots, subgroup = factor(subgroup, levels = subgroup_order))

annots <- annots %>% arrange(subgroup, as.numeric(UPN))

sample_order <- annots$UPN 

Riemondy@meta.data$UPN <- factor(Riemondy@meta.data$UPN, levels = sample_order)
Riemondy@meta.data$subgroup <- factor(Riemondy@meta.data$subgroup, levels = subgroup_order)

Riemondy <- NormalizeData(Riemondy)

Riemondy <- FindVariableFeatures(
  Riemondy,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 4000,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Riemondy <- ScaleData(Riemondy, verbose = TRUE)

Riemondy <- RunPCA(Riemondy, 
             npcs = 40, 
             verbose = FALSE, 
             seed.use = seed_value_Riemondy)

PC_ElbowPlot <- ElbowPlot(Riemondy, ndims = 40)

PC_ElbowPlot

# Save Image
ggsave(file.path(img_dir1_Riemondy, "PC_ElbowPlot_Riemondy_Full_Dataset.png"), plot = PC_ElbowPlot, width = 12, height = 4, bg = "white")
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache = TRUE}

Riemondy <- FindNeighbors(Riemondy, 
                    reduction = "pca", 
                    dims = 1:40, 
                    k.param = 20L)

Riemondy <- RunUMAP(Riemondy, 
              reduction = "pca",
              dims = 1:40,
              min.dist = 0.4, 
              seed.use = seed_value_Riemondy)

Riemondy <- FindClusters(Riemondy, 
                   resolution = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5),
                   random.seed = seed_value_Riemondy)

Riemondy$coarse_clusters <- Riemondy$RNA_snn_res.0.1

Idents(Riemondy) <- "coarse_clusters"

palette_OkabeIto <- c("#dca4ff", "#e1ffac", "#ffda40", "#efe03a", 
                      "#78ffe2", "#f7b5ff", "#89c8ff", "#999999")

UMAPPlot(Riemondy, 
        group.by = "subgroup",    # Group cells by 'subgroup' metadata
        cols = palette_OkabeIto,  
        label = TRUE,             # Display labels
        label.size = 4,           # Set label size
        label.color = "black",    # Set label color
        shuffle = TRUE)  

DimPlot(Riemondy, reduction = "umap", group.by = "subgroup")
cids <- as.numeric(as.character(Riemondy$coarse_clusters)) %>% unique() %>% sort()


```

### Step 3: SHH Isolation, Feature Selection, and Heterogeneity Analysis

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = TRUE}

Riemondy <- subset(Riemondy, subset = subgroup == "SHH")

valid_subpops <- paste0("SHH-", c("A1","A2","B1","B2","C1","C2"))

Riemondy <- subset(
  Riemondy,
  subset = tumor_subpopulation %in% valid_subpops
)

# Feature selection (VST method)
Riemondy <- FindVariableFeatures(
  Riemondy,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 3000
)

# Extract top 10 variable features
top10_Riemondy <- head(VariableFeatures(Riemondy), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable features:", paste(top10_Riemondy, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Variable feature plot
VF_plot1_Riemondy <- VariableFeaturePlot(Riemondy)

# Labeled top features
VF_plot2_Riemondy <- LabelPoints(
  plot   = VF_plot1_Riemondy,
  points = top10_Riemondy,
  repel  = TRUE
)

# Combined visualization
wrap_plots(VF_plot1_Riemondy, VF_plot2_Riemondy, ncol = 2)
```

### Step 4: Data Scaling

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = TRUE}

Riemondy <- ScaleData(Riemondy, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt")
```

### Step 5: PCA

```{r}

Riemondy <- RunPCA(Riemondy, npcs = 50, seed.use = seed_value_Riemondy)

PC_ElbowPlot_Riemondy <- ElbowPlot(Riemondy,ndims = ncol(Embeddings(Riemondy, "pca"))
)

# Save Images
ggsave(file.path(img_dir1_Riemondy, "PC_ElbowPlot_Riemondy.png"),plot = PC_ElbowPlot_Riemondy, width = 12,height = 4,bg = "white")

DimHeatmap(Riemondy,dims = 1:20,cells = 100,balanced = TRUE)

PCs_Heatmap_Riemondy_file <- file.path(img_dir1_Riemondy,"PCs_Heatmap_Riemondy.png")

png(filename = PCs_Heatmap_Riemondy_file,width = 2000,height = 5000,res = 150,bg = "white")

DimHeatmap(Riemondy,dims = 1:20,cells = 100,balanced = TRUE)

dev.off()

PC_ElbowPlot_Riemondy

Idents(Riemondy) <- "tumor_subpopulation"

```

Step 7

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = TRUE}

subpop_colors <- c(
  "SHH-A1" = "red",
  "SHH-A2" = "orange",
  "SHH-B1" = "gold",
  "SHH-B2" = "green",
  "SHH-C1" = "skyblue",
  "SHH-C2" = "violet"
)

Riemondy <- FindNeighbors(Riemondy, dims = 1:30)

Riemondy <- RunUMAP(Riemondy,dims = 1:30,min.dist = 0.3,n.neighbors = 30,seed.use = seed_value_Riemondy
)

Riemondy <- FindClusters(Riemondy,resolution = 0.1,random.seed = seed_value_Riemondy)

p1_Riemondy_Control <- DimPlot(Riemondy,group.by = "tumor_subpopulation",cols = subpop_colors) + ggtitle("Negative Control")

Riemondy <- RunHarmony(Riemondy,group.by.vars = "UPN",theta = 3.0)

Riemondy <- RunUMAP(Riemondy,reduction = "harmony",dims = 1:30,min.dist = 0.3,n.neighbors = 30,seed.use = seed_value_Riemondy)

Riemondy <- FindClusters(Riemondy,resolution = 0.3,random.seed = seed_value_Riemondy)

p2_Riemondy_Harmony <- DimPlot(Riemondy,group.by = "tumor_subpopulation",cols = subpop_colors) + ggtitle("Harmony alignment")

Negative_Control_v_Harmony_Riemondy <- p1_Riemondy_Control | p2_Riemondy_Harmony 
Negative_Control_v_Harmony_Riemondy

# Save Image
ggsave(file.path(img_dir1_Riemondy, "Negative_Control_v_Harmony_Riemondy.png"), plot = Negative_Control_v_Harmony_Riemondy, width = 20, height = 10, bg = "white")

saveRDS(Riemondy, 
        file = file.path(here(), 
                         "Riemondy_analysis", 
                         "results", 
                         "Riemondy_object.rds"),
        compress = "xz")
```
